skills.name: mbse-system-concept
skills.description: Develop or compare system concepts from a problem, desired outcomes, and feasibility constraints.

skills.name: mbse-conops
skills.description: Develop or revise a concept of operations connecting stakeholders, system boundaries, operational use, and lifecycle support.

skills.name: mbse-operational-scenarios
skills.description: Draft or revise operational scenarios with actor actions, system responses, modes, exchanges, and exception recovery.

skills.name: mbse-requirements
skills.description: Elicit, draft, revise, or review engineering requirements and their sources, acceptance conditions, and traceability.

skills.name: mbse-architecture
skills.description: Develop or review functional and physical architectures, requirement allocations, interface contracts, and design trades.

skills.name: mbse-verification-evidence
skills.description: Plan or review requirements verification, stakeholder validation, traceability, and configuration-controlled evidence.

skills.name: mbse-baseline-review
skills.description: Review an engineering baseline or change for consistency, missing allocations, risk controls, verification gaps, and decision readiness.

skills.name: mbse-aerospace
skills.description: Develop or review aerospace architectures, safety and development assurance, and certification evidence for civil aviation or space.

skills.name: mbse-defense
skills.description: Develop or review defense mission threads, DoDAF/UAF architectures, technical baselines, system safety, and acquisition evidence.

skills.name: mbse-automotive
skills.description: Develop or review automotive functional safety, SOTIF, cybersecurity, E/E architectures, and safety evidence.

skills.name: mbse-medical-device
skills.description: Develop or review medical-device intended use, risk controls, software lifecycle, architecture, and regulatory evidence.

skills.name: mbse-electronic-systems
skills.description: Develop or review ASIC, FPGA, SoC, and control-electronics architectures, hardware verification, and assurance evidence.

skills.name: defense-founder-review
skills.description: Evaluate a defense or dual-use venture's capability gap, product wedge, system strategy, and prototype evidence.
